records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2023
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 10% to $135.4 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023 from $123.2 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2023
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 65% of our revenue during the three months ended March 31, 2023, as compared to 60% in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2023
records.text: Software license revenue represented 3% of our revenue during each of the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2023
records.text: The purchase price allocation was not finalized as of the filing date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q and is pending the final determination of the working capital adjustment as well as tax adjustments.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2023
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2023, cash flows used in operating activities were $3.5 million, compared to $14.0 million for the same period in the prior year.
